name: Design #1
scope: Routing elements selected from Yash's HLA alleles, with direct tumour DNA and RNA sequence support.

SEC.sequence_basis: The N-terminal 26 amino acids of Yash's called HLA-C*01:02 protein. DNA and RNA consensus support every encoded base; every codon has RNA support. The first 24 residues form the annotated signal peptide; CS are the two following native residues. The cleavage site has not been measured in this construct.

MITD.sequence_basis: The C-terminal 55 amino acids of Yash's called HLA-B*15:08 protein. DNA and RNA consensus support every encoded base; every codon has RNA support, including the splice-spanning codon at protein residue 338. The complete 165-nt stretch was not covered by one fragment; evidence uses overlapping fragments and linked allele-distinguishing positions.

terminal_join_policy: Jointly optimise terminal and internal linkers using config/linkers.json.
